sources.title: Barbara Kaltenbacher, Convergence rates under a range invariance condition with application to electrical impedance tomography
sources.locator: Complete 27-page PDF. Section 1 equation (1.6), objective equations (1.8) and (1.11), penalty and compatibility equations (2.20)–(2.23), Theorem 3 parameter condition (2.5), proof, and equations (2.10)–(2.16), frozen-Newton §2.3 equations (2.31)–(2.41), EIT Example 2 equations (1.18)–(1.24), Section 3 Theorem 10 and Corollary 11 (printed p. 24).
sources.disposition: Primary full-text source for the factorization, augmented objectives, joint and frozen rate strategies, and the reported EIT specialization. The joint argument is reproduced locally. The frozen proof uses a directly verified, more conservative triangle-power estimate because the paper's displayed equation (2.39) comparison is not justified by its norm-power objective for general p. EIT assertions are recorded for reconciliation and are not claimed as established.
